facts.fact: NITDA issued the Nigerian Government Enterprise Architecture (NGEA) v1.0, status Released, March 2019, under the NITDA Act 2007, as a framework for all public institutions whose data reference model points to the Ne-GIF for data sharing and exchange.
The NGEA's document metadata lists its enforcement category as Recommended, and its sections 4.3 and 4.4 only encourage federal public institutions to set up EA teams and units.
